name: nport_fund_owners
description: Which mutual funds and ETFs hold a given stock or bond, ranked by position size, from SEC Form N-PORT portfolio filings — the reverse of a fund fact sheet, which makes you name the fund first. Give a ticker ("NVDA"), a company name ("NVIDIA"), or a CUSIP. Returns each fund, its sponsor, the position value, share or principal count, and what percent of that fund's net assets it is. Answers "which ETFs hold the largest positions in NVDA", "what funds own this corporate bond", "who are the biggest fund holders of this stock".

security.description: Ticker, company name, or CUSIP. A ticker resolves through OpenFIGI to the underlying company.

quarter.description: Release to search, e.g. "2026q2". Omit to search everything loaded.

name: nport_fund_portfolio
description: The portfolio a mutual fund or ETF reported to the SEC on Form N-PORT: its largest positions with issuer, value, share or principal count, and percent of net assets. Give the fund or ETF series name ("Vanguard Total Stock Market Index Fund", "SPDR S&P 500 ETF"). Answers "what does this ETF hold", "what are this fund's biggest positions", "how much of this fund is in one stock".

fund.description: Fund or ETF series name, or a fragment of it.

quarter.description: Release to read, e.g. "2026q2". Omit for everything loaded.

name: nport_holdings_coverage
description: Which SEC Form N-PORT releases are loaded, how many funds each carries, the newest reporting period, and what the data does and does not cover. Also reports N-CEN fund-profile coverage (nport_fund_profile). Use this to check how current fund holdings and profile answers are before quoting them.

name: nport_fund_profile
description: A mutual fund or ETF's profile from SEC Form N-CEN, the annual fund census: ETF/index/money-market status (an explicit flag, which N-PORT holdings filings do not carry), AUM, expense ratio, advisory fee, NAV and market price per share, and its investment adviser(s). Also covers ETFs organized as unit investment trusts (SPY, QQQ, DIA) via N-CEN's separate UIT section — fund_type "unit investment trust", total assets, and administrator(s), but no expense ratio/advisory fee/NAV (Part F does not report those). Give the fund or ETF name ("Vanguard Total Stock Market Index Fund", "SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust"). Answers "is this fund an ETF", "what's this fund's expense ratio", "who manages this fund", "how big is this fund's AUM". Does NOT cover inception date — N-CEN carries no such field — or portfolio holdings (use nport_fund_portfolio for that). Response discloses a name_match grade (exact/starts_with/contains) and other candidates, since a substring match is never presented as the fund without saying so.

fund.description: Fund or ETF name, or a fragment of it.
